note: Export side is factually confirmed by dated customs/B-L records, not by website claims: outbound shipments to Sri Lanka (BOL 1033904, HS 32099090), Thailand (BOL 1010581, HS 35069999) and Kuwait (BOL 9949383, HS 40169940), latest record 2026-02-28, with repeat buyers in UAE, Tanzania, USA, Uganda and Brazil. Declared HS 392099 does not match the observed export HS codes (32099090, 35069999, 40169940) nor the import side (38140029, 39045090) — per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground: the company stays in the base, the HS code is corrected to the actual observed codes, verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Note the declared industry 'Нефтегаз и химия' is only partly right: actual trade is printing/offset consumables (plate chemicals, glues, rubber offset blankets, aluminium foil/plates) — graphic-arts chemistry, not oil & gas. Revenue and export volume figures are not public in the sources read: null, not estimated. Domestic (India) supply evidence not found in accessible sources — stated plainly, not softened. Second slug variant 'technova-imaging-systems-pvt-ltd' returned an empty page (no rows), so the canonical slug is the only substantive record.
